warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 80 to 90 km/h are possible across alpine above 1900 metres from this morning, peaking late this evening. Winds are forecast to ease below warning thresholds before dawn on Wednesday. Locations which may be affected include Thredbo Top Station.

warnings.desc: DAMAGING WIND GUSTS of up to 100 km/h are possible about the alpine ranges from this afternoon, peaking later in the evening. Winds are forecast to ease below warning thresholds before dawn on Wednesday. Locations which may be affected include Falls Creek, Mt Hotham and Mt Buller.

warnings.desc: DAMAGING WIND GUSTS of about 100 km/h are possible over elevated parts of southern and eastern Tasmania from late this morning, peaking during the afternoon. Winds are forecast to ease below warning thresholds in the evening. Locations which may be affected include Strathgordon.
